NotFound,\n    Conflict,\n    Forbidden,\n}\n\n/// Parse a non-empty id that follows a fixed prefix and ends with a suffix.\n///\n/// Returns `None` if the id is empty or contains an additional `/` segment.\nfn parse_play_suffix<'a>(path: &'a str, prefix: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<&'a str> {\n    let rest = path.strip_prefix(prefix)?;\n    let id = rest.strip_suffix(suffix)?;\n    if id.is_empty() || id.contains('/') {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some(id)\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id and a nested sub-resource id from a path.\n///\n/// The path shape is `/v1/play/campaigns/{campaign_id}{marker}{sub_id}{suffix}`.\n/// Both identifiers must be non-empty and must not contain additional segments\n/// before the marker or suffix.\nfn parse_play_nested<'a>(\n    path: &'a str,\n    prefix: &'a str,\n    marker: &'a str,\n    suffix: &'a str,\n) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    let rest = path.strip_prefix(prefix)?;\n    let mid = rest.find(marker)?;\n    let campaign_id = &rest[..mid];\n    if campaign_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let after = &rest[mid + marker.len()..];\n    let sub_id = after.strip_suffix(suffix)?;\n    if sub_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some((campaign_id, sub_id))\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id and encounter id from an encounter sub-resource path.\nfn parse_play_encounter_base<'a>(path: &'a str, suffix: &'a str) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str)> {\n    parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/encounters/\", suffix)\n}\n\n/// Parse a campaign id, encounter id, and a final resource id from an encounter\n/// resource path such as `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/encounters/{enc_id}/monsters/{m_id}`.\nfn parse_play_encounter_resource<'a>(\n    path: &'a str,\n    resource: &'a str,\n) -> Option<(&'a str, &'a str, &'a str)> {\n    let (campaign_id, after) = parse_play_nested(path, \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", \"/encounters/\", \"\")?;\n    let marker = format!(\"/{}/\", resource);\n    let mid = after.find(&marker)?;\n    let encounter_id = &after[..mid];\n    let resource_id = &after[mid + marker.len()..];\n    if encounter_id.is_empty() || resource_id.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some((campaign_id, encounter_id, resource_id))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play \"/v1/play/campaigns/\", suffix)\n}\n\n/// Create a new play campaign.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns\n///\n/// The body must contain non-empty `id` and `name` and a positive\n/// `max_players`. {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    if !play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, _phase, _turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let (character_id, character_name) =\n        play_campaign_member_character(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let narrations = play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    let is_my_turn = current_actor == actor;\n    let mut events_json = Vec::new();\n    for (sequence, kind, event_actor, text) in narrations {\n        events_json.push(format!(\n            r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"{}\",\"actor\":\"{}\",\"text\":\"{}\"}}\"#,\n            sequence,\n            escape_json(&kind),\n            escape_json(&event_actor),\n            escape_json(&text)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"is_my_turn\":{},\"current_actor\":\"{}\",\"character\":{{\"id\":\"{}\",\"name\":\"{}\"}},\"recent_events\":[{}]}}\"#,\n        is_my_turn,\n        escape_json(&current_actor),\n        escape_json(&character_id),\n        escape_json(&character_name),\n        events_json.join(\",\")\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Read the GM turn status for a play campaign.\n///\n/// GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may read this endpoint. The\n/// resolution is appended as a public event and the turn advances to the next\n/// party member with an incremented turn number.\npub fn resolve_turn(campaign_id: &str, body: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != \"dm\" || (phase != \"dm\" && phase != \"exploration\") {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    let text = extract_string(body, \"text\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if text.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if members.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let next_index = (turn_number % members.len() as i64) as usize;\n    let next_actor = members[next_index].0.clone();\n    let new_turn_number = turn_number + 1;\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"resolution\", \"dm\", text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, &next_actor, \"player\", new_turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"resolution\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"{}\",\"next_actor\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":{}}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(text),\n        escape_json(&next_actor),\n        new_turn_number\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign scene sub-resource path.\n///\n/// For example, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/scenes/{scene_id}/enter` This migration runs\n/// unconditionally on startup and adds any missing columns with safe defaults.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"status\",\n        \"status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"death_saves_successes\",\n        \"death_saves_successes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"death_saves_failures\",\n        \"death_saves_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add a missing owner column to an existing play_campaign_members table and\n/// backfill existing rows so that every character is linked to its player\n/// identity.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the character-ownership stage lack `owner`.\n/// This migration runs unconditionally on startup and adds the missing column\n/// with an empty default, then sets the owner to the member actor for any row\n/// that does not yet have an owner.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members_owner() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"owner\",\n        \"owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )?;\n    sqlite_exec(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET owner = actor WHERE owner = '';\")\n}\n\n/// Add missing reward columns to an existing play_encounters table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the encounter rewards stage lack\n/// `xp_awarded` and `rewards_awarded`. This migration runs\n/// unconditionally on startup and adds any missing columns with safe\n/// defaults.\nfn migrate_play_encounters_rewards() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_encounters\",\n        \"xp_awarded\",\n        \"xp_awarded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_encounters\",\n        \"rewards_awarded\",\n        \"rewards_awarded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add missing build columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the character-creation-choices stage lack\n/// `race`, `background`, and `level`. This migration runs unconditionally on\n/// startup and adds any missing columns with safe defaults.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members_build() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"race\",\n        \"race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"background\",\n        \"background TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"level\",\n        \"level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add missing ability-score columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the skills-and-proficiencies stage lack the\n/// six ability score columns. This migration runs unconditionally on startup\n/// and adds the missing columns with a default of 0 (meaning \"not set\").\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members_abilities() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_str\",\n        \"ability_str INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_dex\",\n        \"ability_dex INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_con\",\n        \"ability_con INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_int\",\n        \"ability_int INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_wis\",\n        \"ability_wis INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_cha\",\n        \"ability_cha INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add missing exploration-actor column to an existing play_campaigns table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the combat/exploration transition stage lack\n/// `exploration_actor`. This migration runs unconditionally on startup and\n/// adds the missing column with an empty default.\nfn migrate_play_campaigns_exploration_actor() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaigns\",\n        \"exploration_actor\",\n        \"exploration_actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add spell-slot and cast-history tables if they do not already exist.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the spell-casting stage lack these tables.\n/// This migration runs unconditionally on startup and creates any missing\n/// tables.\nfn migrate_play_character_spell_tables() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_character_spell_slots (\n            campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            slot_level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            slots_remaining INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, character_id, slot_level)\n        );\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_character_casts (\n            campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            spell_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            target TEXT NOT NULL,\n            slot_level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            slots_remaining INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, character_id, sequence)\n        );\n    \"#;\n    sqlite_exec(sql)\n}\n\n/// Add the concentration table if it does not already exist.\nfn migrate_play_character_concentration_table() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_character_concentration (\n            campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            spell_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            target TEXT NOT NULL,\n            remaining_turns INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, character_id)\n        );\n    \"#;\n    sqlite_exec(sql)\n}\n\n/// Drop all application tables and recreate a fresh schema.\n///\n/// This is a destructive operation used by the storage reset endpoint.\npub fn reset_db() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS schema_meta;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combat_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combatants;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS conditions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monsters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monster_tags;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS items;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS events;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS npcs;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS factions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS quest_milestones;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS quests;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS characters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaigns;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS character_equipment;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_inventory;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS crafting_projects;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS session_attendance;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS session_agenda;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaigns;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaign_members;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_narrations;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaign_documents;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_scenes;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_locations;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_location_connections;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_monsters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_combatants;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_conditions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_order;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_loot;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_spells;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_prepared_spells;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_spell_slots;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_casts;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_concentration;\n    \"#;\n    sqlite_exec(sql)?;\n    init_db()\n}\n\n/// Return the current schema version and initialization flag.\n///\n/// If the schema_meta row is missing or the query fails, the database is\n/// reported as uninitialized with version 0.\npub fn storage_status() -> Result<(i64, bool), String> {\n    let sql = \"SELECT version, initialized FROM schema_meta WHERE version = 1;\";\n    match sqlite_query(sql) {\n        Ok(output) => {\n            let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            let objects = extract_objects(content);\n            if objects.is_empty() {\n                return Ok((0, false));\n            }\n            let obj = objects[0];\n            let version = extract_int(obj, \"version\").unwrap_or(0);\n            let initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing role\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql = format!(\n        \"SELECT 1 FROM {} WHERE slug = '{}';\",\n        table,\n        sql_escape(slug)\n    );\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n    Ok(!output.trim().is_empty())\n}\n\npub fn NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'\"`. This is used by the startup\n/// migrations to make older schemas forward-compatible without altering\n/// behavior for newly created databases.\nfn add_column_if_missing(table: &str, column: &str, definition: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = format!(\"PRAGMA table_info({});\", table);\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let has_column = extract_objects(content)\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|o| extract_string(o, \"name\"))\n        .any(|name| name == column);\n    if !has_column {\n        sqlite_exec(&format!(\"ALTER TABLE {} ADD COLUMN {};\", table, definition))?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Add missing death-save columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the death-saves stage lack `status`,\n/// `death_saves_successes`, and `death_saves_failures`. This migration runs\n/// unconditionally on startup and adds any missing columns with safe defaults.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"status\",\n        \"status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"death_saves_successes\",\n        \"death_saves_successes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"death_saves_failures\",\n        \"death_saves_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add a missing owner column to an existing play_campaign_members table and\n/// backfill existing rows so that every character is linked to its player\n/// identity.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the character-ownership stage lack `owner`.\n/// This migration runs unconditionally on startup and adds the missing column\n/// with an empty default, then sets the owner to the member actor for any row\n/// that does not yet have an owner.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members_owner() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"owner\",\n        \"owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )?;\n    sqlite_exec(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET owner = actor WHERE owner = '';\")\n}\n\n/// Add missing reward columns to an existing play_encounters table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the encounter rewards stage lack\n/// `xp_awarded` and `rewards_awarded`. This migration runs\n/// unconditionally on startup and adds any missing columns with safe\n/// defaults.\nfn migrate_play_encounters_rewards() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_encounters\",\n        \"xp_awarded\",\n        \"xp_awarded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_encounters\",\n        \"rewards_awarded\",\n        \"rewards_awarded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add missing build columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the character-creation-choices stage lack\n/// `race`, `background`, and `level`. This migration runs unconditionally on\n/// startup and adds any missing columns with safe defaults.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members_build() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"race\",\n        \"race TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"background\",\n        \"background TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"level\",\n        \"level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add missing ability-score columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the skills-and-proficiencies stage lack the\n/// six ability score columns. This migration runs unconditionally on startup\n/// and adds the missing columns with a default of 0 (meaning \"not set\").\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members_abilities() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_str\",\n        \"ability_str INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_dex\",\n        \"ability_dex INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_con\",\n        \"ability_con INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_int\",\n        \"ability_int INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_wis\",\n        \"ability_wis INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"ability_cha\",\n        \"ability_cha INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add missing exploration-actor column to an existing play_campaigns table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the combat/exploration transition stage lack\n/// `exploration_actor`. This migration runs unconditionally on startup and\n/// adds the missing column with an empty default.\nfn migrate_play_campaigns_exploration_actor() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaigns\",\n        \"exploration_actor\",\n        \"exploration_actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add spell-slot and cast-history tables if they do not already exist.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the spell-casting stage lack these tables.\n/// This migration runs unconditionally on startup and creates any missing\n/// tables.\nfn migrate_play_character_spell_tables() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_character_spell_slots (\n            campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            slot_level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            slots_remaining INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, character_id, slot_level)\n        );\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_character_casts (\n            campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            spell_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            target TEXT NOT NULL,\n            slot_level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            slots_remaining INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, character_id, sequence)\n        );\n    \"#;\n    sqlite_exec(sql)\n}\n\n/// Add the concentration table if it does not already exist.\nfn migrate_play_character_concentration_table() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_character_concentration (\n            campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            character_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            spell_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n            target TEXT NOT NULL,\n            remaining_turns INTEGER NOT NULL,\n            PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, character_id)\n        );\n    \"#;\n    sqlite_exec(sql)\n}\n\n/// Drop all application tables and recreate a fresh schema.\n///\n/// This is a destructive operation used by the storage reset endpoint.\npub fn reset_db() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS schema_meta;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combat_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combatants;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS conditions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monsters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monster_tags;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS items;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS events;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS npcs;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS factions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS quest_milestones;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS quests;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS characters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaigns;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS character_equipment;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_inventory;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS crafting_projects;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS session_attendance;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS session_agenda;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaigns;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaign_members;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_narrations;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaign_documents;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_scenes;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_locations;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_location_connections;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_monsters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_combatants;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_conditions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_order;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_loot;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_spells;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_prepared_spells;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_spell_slots;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_casts;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_concentration;\n    \"#;\n    sqlite_exec(sql)?;\n    init_db()\n}\n\n/// Return the current schema version and initialization flag.\n///\n/// If the schema_meta row is missing or the query fails, the database is\n/// reported as uninitialized with version 0.\npub fn storage_status() -> Result<(i64, bool), String> {\n    let sql = \"SELECT version, initialized FROM schema_meta WHERE version = 1;\";\n    match sqlite_query(sql) {\n        Ok(output) => {\n            let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            let objects = extract_objects(content);\n            if objects.is_empty() {\n                return Ok((0, false));\n            }\n            let obj = objects[0];\n            let version = extract_int(obj, \"version\").unwrap_or(0);\n            let initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing role\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql = format!(\n        \"SELECT 1 FROM {} WHERE slug = '{}';\",\n        table,\n        sql_escape(slug)\n    );\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n    Ok(!output.trim().is_empty())\n}\n\npub fn prepared spell by consuming a spell slot.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/characters/{character_id}/casts\n///\n/// Only the character owner may cast. escape_json(spell_id),\n                escape_json(target),\n                slot_level,\n                slots_remaining,\n                sequence\n            )\n        })\n        .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n        .join(\",\");\n    Ok(format!(r#\"{{\"casts\":[{}]}}\"#, casts_json))\n}\n\n/// Format the canonical concentration response for a character.\nfn
